rationale: The response is an unapologetic, indignant sworn-defense that reframes the allegation as an affront to American heritage (mentions title, registration, familial BBQ lineage) and remains in hearing-testimony register throughout. quote: The allegation that my 2008 Ford F-150 is a rental from Enterprise or U-Haul is not only categorically false, it is an insult to everything this Cookout stands for.
